### What to Do If You Wake Up Feeling Fragile
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/what-to-do-if-you-wake-up-feeling-fragile
Passage: Zechariah 2:4-5
Points:
- Believers often experience mornings burdened with feelings of fragility, vulnerability, and anxiety.
- God sustains His children when they cry out for help and seek out His specific promises in Scripture.
- The vision of an unwalled Jerusalem portrays rapid growth and abundance that exceeds human containment.
- While unwalled towns seem vulnerable, God pledges to serve as an impenetrable wall of fire surrounding His people.
- God provides not only fiery defense against outside threats, but also the comforting pleasure of His presence within.
